answer.answer: PMJDY provides universal banking services including basic savings bank accounts, access to need-based credit, remittances, insurance, and pension to unbanked and underserved populations [E03]. From the Ministry of Finance, the Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) finances income-generating micro-enterprises by facilitating micro credit/loans up to Rs. 20 lakhs to non-farm sector activities in manufacturing, trading, and service sectors [E01].
